draft.subject: Your bulk-import question
draft.body:
Hi Tunde,

Thanks for the note about importing from a spreadsheet instead of adding one at a time - your ticket is still open with us and I'm keeping an eye on it. On the teammate side, teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time, and you can invite from Account Settings -> Members at any time. For the contacts side of your question, I'd rather get you a precise answer than guess.

You've already got a project set up, and projects are the main organizing unit with tasks inside them. Want to do a 20-minute call this week to get the first tasks moving?

Best,
Priya
